text.p: The annualised average yield on an issue of 364-day Russian GKO discount Treasury bills was 18.89 percent at an auction on Wednesday, the central bank said.
Dealers had forecast the yield would be in the 18.77-19.07 percent range.
The series 21079 bills, maturing on July 15, 1998, the closest maturity date to the new issue, closed on Tuesday at 84.90 to yield 18.92 percent.
On July 23 the Finance Ministry will offer eight trillion roubles in an issue of 728-day OFZ discount Treasury bills (series 24016).
It will also repay 6.45 trillion roubles in a maturing issue of 210-day T-bills (series 22064).

It will also pay 237.83 billion roubles in interest on the two-year OFZ interest-bearing government bond (series 24009) maturing October 1998. It will also offer to repay the bond early on a voluntary basis. About 3.15 trillion roubles of the bond is outstanding.
